desc: A handheld (an AYN Odin, a Steam Deck): the touch controls on and one controller in port 1 (its built-in controls, a virtual controller here) pressing its buttons: it stays player 1's, the touch controls hide for it, and co-op stays off (nobody is player 2, one player), with Co-op (up to 4 players) on as by default. The playtest's Odin had its built-in controls moved to player 2 and co-op going on by itself. Shot: field (no 2P tag, no touch controls)
log_must: \[seats\] 480: port 1 pad 1, port 2 none; player 2 nobody; 1 playing; player 1 on the touch screen 1
\[seats\] 780: port 1 pad 1, port 2 none; player 2 nobody; 1 playing; player 1 on the touch screen 0; co-op setting 1
